 “Super Troopers 3” Coming Soon To Hulu & Disney+ 
 October 28, 2026 
 Roger Palmer 
 Disney has announced details on the streaming release of the Searchlight Pictures film, “Super Troopers 3”, which is coming soon to Hulu and Disney+.
 In this film, everyone’s favourite cops are back with “Super Troopers 3”, the third installment of the comedy classic. When Farva’s over-the-top engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship while trying to crack a drug ring — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.
 It’s been 25 years sing the first film was released and once again, the Super Troopers find themselves caught between questionable police work and complete mayhem, resulting in complete buffoonery, pure chaos, and just a touch of delicious maple syrup.
 Directed by Jay Chandrasekhar and written by Broken Lizard, Super Troopers 3 reunites Jay Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. The film also stars Hannah Simone, Nat Faxon, Chace Crawford, Andrew Dismukes, Marisa Coughlan, Jon Rudnitsky, Lisa Gilroy, Sakina Jaffrey, Iqbal Theba, Lynda Carter and Brian Cox.
 The movie will be coming to Hulu and Hulu On Disney+ in the United States and on Disney+ around the world on November 5th 2026, just ninety days after the theatrical release. The first two films are also available to stream on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ in the United States and on Disney+ around the world.
 Just ahead of the streaming release, fans of the film can report for duty at LA Comic Con from October 30th 2026 through November 1st 2026 at the Los Angeles Convention Center. This three-day activation will transport con-goers straight into a scene from the film, serve up exclusive giveaways, and give fans the chance to meet members of the Broken Lizard comedy team who will be stopping by on Friday of the convention. Join us meow at Booth #708, South Hall. Tickets are on sale now at ComicConLA.com.
 Are you looking forward to watching “Super Troopers 3”? Let me know on social media!
